items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Ruled out for Monday night
items.text:
Croskey-Merritt (groin) has been ruled out for Monday night's game against the 49ers, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Pat Freiermuth: Dealing with calf injury, iffy for Week 6
items.text:
Freiermuth (calf) was added to the injury report Saturday and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Tampa Bay, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DK Metcalf: Cleared for Week 6
items.text:
The Steelers removed Metcalf (illness) from the injury report Saturday, and the veteran wide receiver will be available for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane: On track to be activated from IR
items.text:
Lane (wrist) is "good to go" after practicing fully this week and is expected to be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Browns, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Stefon Diggs: Spotted at Saturday's practice
items.text:
Diggs (hamstring) was on the field for Saturday's practice session, Jonah Keim of ESPN.com reports.
